clue.text: On table, plan to imbibe European drink

parts.note: a chart is a table of data

indicators.note: to imbibe is to drink in, so the plan word takes the European letter inside it

explanation.surface: Someone spreads out a plan on a table before having a drink.
explanation.walkthrough: 'On' is a link word here. CHARTREUSE is a green or yellow French herbal liqueur, named after the monastery where monks make it.
explanation.definitionFit: Chartreuse is a herbal liqueur made by Carthusian monks, so it is a kind of alcoholic beverage.

clue.text: Truncheon cracked on someone's head, initially

explanation.definitionFit: A cosh is a short heavy club, the same kind of weapon as a police baton.

parts.note: torn means ripped or gashed

explanation.surface: Someone cut by a stiff barb grabs at it.
explanation.definitionFit: A thorn is a sharp pointed growth on a plant, a natural spike.

clue.text: Set up before court ended, discontented

indicators.note: discontented, read as losing its contents, keeps only the outside letters of the word ended

explanation.surface: Something was arranged before an unhappy court case finished.
explanation.definitionFit: To set up a structure is to put it up, the same as building it.

parts.note: nice means pleasant

explanation.definitionFit: Brunette describes brown hair, or a woman with it, so the colour word fits.

clue.text: Cheered and felt again embracing sweetheart

explanation.walkthrough: 'sweetheart' is the crossword convention for the heart of sweet, its middle letter; 'embracing' is the container indicator.
explanation.definitionFit: Being relieved after worry leaves you comforted and happier, cheered up.

clue.text: Remove skin cells occasionally with this?

clue.text: Quiet occupant could be top person

explanation.definitionFit: A president is the leader of a nation or organisation, the person at the top.

parts.note: reads like a biblical epistle, but means the fifth letter of the alphabet the Greeks of Corinth used

explanation.walkthrough: St Paul wrote two letters to the Corinthians, so a fifth sends you to the Bible; Corinth was Greek, and the Greek alphabet's fifth character is meant.
explanation.definitionFit: Epsilon is the fifth character of the Greek alphabet, used in ancient Corinth.

parts.note: no means none at all, zero

indicators.note: in places the below word inside the ship letters

under means below

indicators.note: following puts the fall-over word after the small letter
